person_note: The base narration is third person, with chapters alternating focalization between Jo and Bethie rather than alternating grammatical person. Goodreads event passages repeatedly narrate both sisters externally and use free-indirect access to their thoughts; first- and second-person forms in the quote set belong to dialogue, prayer, embedded thought, or universal maxims. Three authorized excerpts independently cover the Jo opening, a Bethie section, and later interior Bethie prose, all in third person. One scholarly paper labels the structure alternating first person, but its wording is directly falsified by the primary-text excerpts and is best understood as a confusion between viewpoint character and narrative person. No sustained first- or second-person base section was found.
